content.title: Nick Viall and Natalie Joy: What’s the Age Gap Between the Age of Attraction Hosts?
content.text: Age-gap relationships, like the one between Nick Viall and Natalie Joy, seem to be all the rage right now. From Babygirl to Vladimir to Bridget Jones 4, women cavorting with much younger men are all over our screens. And now those on-screen age-gap relationships aren't just fictional. With Age of Attraction, Netflix is treating us to age-gap relationships, reality-TV-style. After all, the streamer has already proven that love can sometimes be blind—can it also be ageless?Age of Attraction hosts Viall and Joy certainly think so. The IRL married couple who is leading the cast of singles through their age-blind dating experience have a pretty significant age gap—and are trying to prove to the cast and to viewers at home that, sometimes, age is just a number when it comes to love.Just how big is that age difference? Here’s what we know about Nick Viall and Natalie Joy’s relationship.© 2026 Netflix, Inc.What is Nick Viall and Natalie Joy’s age difference?Nick Viall, 45, is 18 years older than Natalie Joy, 27.Viall has had his fair share of experience in the world of reality TV dating. He appeared on The Bachelorette as a contestant in 2014 and returned in 2015. In 2016 he appeared in Bachelor in Paradise and was later the star of the 21st season of The Bachelor.Viall finally found love off-screen with Natalie Joy, a model and surgical technologist, in July 2020 after she DM’d him on Instagram. The pair announced their engagement in January 2023. That August they announced they were expecting their first child together, and in February 2024 they welcomed daughter River Rose Viall. They wed in April 2024.© 2026 Netflix, Inc.“We obviously have an age gap, and it’ something that has been talked about, whether good, whether bad,” Joy told E!. “This [show] is something that going into it—it’s a bright light on age differences and relationships of age differences.”Added Viall, “Speaking about Natalie and I, it’s the most compatible relationship I’ve ever had. I could go on and on about it. We spend a lot of time together—our free time, raising our daughter, we enjoy doing things together. We have a great connection.”The couple is currently expecting twins.© 2026 Netflix, Inc.What ages are the Age of Attraction cast?If you’ve already tuned into Netflix’s new reality dating show, you are probably wondering just how old the cast members really are. Unfortunately, part of the fun is keeping all of that a secret—both for the participants and for us viewers. What we do know is that the cast is made up of singles ranging from their early 20s to their 60s—so there are bound to be some age-gap relationships already brewing.Find out more about the Age of Attraction cast here.This article first appeared on Glamour UK.
